scope: Native Windows integration only. Both architectures passed ten scoped disconnected COM comparisons and two candidate-only empty autoloader ID controls, then 798 renderer cases / 8426 frames and 32 mutation cases / 224 frames. Autoloader reference QueryId/FindPin remain excluded, not parity passes. No graph playback, custom interface methods, UI or real host validation.
